items.briefing:
Australian finance teams are being warned about a growing risk of payment scams, with a key vulnerability being that staff may treat transactions as routine numbers rather than recognising the human and security decisions involved. Scammers are increasingly targeting payment processes — such as invoices and bank account changes — to trick employees into transferring money to fraudulent accounts. All staff handling payments should be on alert, not just IT teams.

If you receive a request to change bank details or approve an urgent payment, always verify directly with the requestor by phone using a known number — not contact details from the email itself.
